items.summary: The conflict that tore through New England 350 years ago was the bloodiest per capita in colonial or US history Massachusetts is proud of its ties to the American Revolution. From Paul Revere’s Ride to the siege of Boston, the past year-plus has been devoted to celebrating 250 years of US independence. Yet during this time, the state, and New England in general, has given far less attention to an older, more complex remembrance: The 350th anniversary of King Philip’s war. King Philip, or Metacom, was an Indigenous leader from the Pokanoket people. Catch up quick: The Census Bureau proposed in September to stop asking Americans about their race and ethnicity on the once-a-decade census. The Census Bureau says a shorter form could encourage more people to respond, while greater use of existing government records would reduce the need to ask certain questions. It is the first-ever Olympic sporting event to be held on the African continent, but comes as Senegal faces an economic crisis. The country's president has said he wants to turn sport into an “economic and social engine”. The Games also come amid a government crackdown on LGBTQ+ people. Nearly 3,000 teenagers from more than 200 countries are competing in around a dozen sports, including athletics, beach wrestling and a five-a-side version of baseball. The Shermans identified two priorities in their game plan: control time of possession and limit Northwest's ability to produce explosive plays. Unioto had the football for over 33 minutes, compared to Northwest's 14. Defensively, the Shermans made Northwest work for everything, forcing three turnovers while surrendering just 193 yards of total offense. The result was a 17-0 win over the Knights Friday night, Oct. 30, giving the program its third playoff victory and second consecutive trip to Week 12.

Florida will wear white jerseys for the neutral site game against Georgia in Atlanta at Mercedes Benz Stadium. Michigan is 4-1 in games played at Rutgers, including a 52-17 victory in its most recent trip to Piscataway in 2022. The Wolverines (4-3, 1-3 Big Ten) are coming off a 13-6 overtime loss to No. 6 Indiana last week at Michigan Stadium. Michigan has lost three of its past four games and is still seeking its first road victory of the season under coach Kyle Whittingham. Freshman quarterback Tommy Carr made his first career start against Indiana, completing 20 of 32 passes for 167 yards and an interception. Carr is expected to make his second consecutive start Saturday as Michigan looks to generate more offense after managing just six points against the Hoosiers.

Morton High School took care of business in the IHSA Class 5A football playoffs Oct. 30 with a big win over Lemont. How it happened, right here. The Potters looked sharp and cruised to a 45-14 win over Lemont on Friday, Oct. 30 in the first round of the Class 5A high school football playoffs. Morton (9-1) now heads into next weekend's second round, hosting Troy Triad (9-1) — a 24-7 winner over Washington. "(The bye week) helped us," Morton senior Soren Fifer said. "But we stay game ready. It just gave us more time to prepare. ... It felt awesome to get out there after a week off."

Joc Pederson opts out of an $18.5M deal with Texas. The 2021 World Series hero hits free agency after a strong 2026 season. Should Atlanta bring him back? The 34-year-old slugger is coming off a season where he proved he still has plenty of power left in his bat. He hit 26 home runs in 136 games last year and posted an OPS+ of 134. That number shows he was well above the league average. It is a strong resume for a player looking to sign his next big deal. The Texas Rangers will likely try to keep him, but the Braves have a clear need to fill.

Ja Morant suffers a Grade 2 hamstring strain and will miss at least a month. The Blazers lose their star just as the season begins. The timing is brutal for a franchise trying to find its footing. Morant was averaging 15.8 points and 5.5 assists through the first four games. He shot a career-best 42.9 percent from three-point range, a stat that now looks like a fleeting high point. The Blazers confirmed he will be re-evaluated in four weeks. That timeline means he likely returns in late November or early December. Portland now faces a long stretch without its best player while trying to build momentum.

Stephen Curry and Luka Doncic are putting on a show in the latest Lakers-Warriors matchup. Doncic helped the Los Angeles Lakers pull ahead early, scoring 21 points in the first quarter as the Lakers took a 38-15 lead against the Golden State Warriors . Curry and the Warriors responded with a 38-15 run of their own in the second quarter to tie the game at 53 at halftime. Golden State became the first team during the shot-clock era (since 1954-55) to trail by as many as 23 after the opening quarter and then tie the game by halftime.

Miles McBride averages just 6.4 points in five games, raising doubts about his future. Daily Knicks says trade talks may be next for the guard. McBride has played in five games so far, but he has only shown real promise in one matchup against the Boston Celtics. In that single game, he dropped 20 points and hit six of his eight three-point attempts. The other four outings tell a different story, with the former second-round pick shooting just 4-for-19 from the field. The Daily Knicks noted that he is also below average at grabbing rebounds and setting up teammates. A player who cannot create for others or finish at the rim struggles to stay on the floor.

Luka Dončić further cemented himself in the Lakers' history books. Dončić's 21 points in the opening quarter of the Lakers' Friday road game against the Warriors was his 33rd career 20-point quarter and 10th 20-point quarter as a Laker. He joined Kobe Bryant as the only two Lakers players to record at least 10 20-point quarters since 2000. The late franchise icon recorded 36 20-point quarters between 2000 and his retirement in 2016. Dončić also passed James Harden for the third-most 20-point quarters in the NBA since 2000.

The quarterback threw eight touchdowns, four in the first quarter, in a rout of Denton Brasswell. Beyond that for the No. 7 ranked team in Class 6A? That's what the playoffs are for. Behind Brassfield, his dominating offensive line and some kicking game breaks, Lewisville jumped out to a 31-0 lead in the first quarter and went on to a District 5-6A-clinching 58-14 win over Denton Braswell at Max Goldsmith Stadium on Friday night. "It was big," Lewisville coach Michael Odle said. "We knew it was right here. We wanted to come out and make a statement. We didn't play well last week. We knew we needed to win this game to hoist that gold ball. Kudos to the kids. They bought into what we did all…

Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) reacts during the first half of an NBA Cup basketball game against the Golden State Warriors in San Francisco.Luka Doncic was certainly feeling... In the middle of his dominant first-half performance, where the Lakers star scored 24 points, Doncic sank a 3-pointer, turned around and looked at the Warriors crowd at Chase Center. Ali Bayan assured the little girl that the trip to his home country of Jordan was a "surprise" — and that her mother, Cathy Mahone, knew all about it. But as days turned into weeks and her father refused to let her speak to her mother, Burns began to realize she might never return home.

Raquel Alvarez Tabernero/Shutterstock Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover In a casual conversation, you could maybe get away with using the acronyms GPS and GNSS interchangeably. The two are closely related, in the same way that an iPhone is a type of smartphone. GNSS stands for Global Navigation Satellite System, a broad term for any satellite navigation system, including GPS. NASA describes it as providing "autonomous geospatial positioning" because, of course, they do. The most important takeaway is that GPS, as familiar as it is to everyone, is merely a type of GNSS, specifically the United States' satellite navigation system.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have six players entering arbitration this offseason, and they need to decide how to approach them. The standard number of arbitration years is three, but players in the top 22% can earn the Super Two Exception, which lets them enter arbitration a year early and get four total years. In arbitration, a team must decide whether to tender or non-tender players by November 20th. If they are tendered, they continue to arbitration; if they are non-tendered, they become free agents. Once tendered, the team and player can agree to avoid arbitration or go to a hearing, where both sides submit a salary proposal and a third-party arbitrator rules for the player or team.

DeMonica Amerson was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis at 21. Nearly two decades later, she received devastating news. DeMonica Amerson's diagnosis of multiple sclerosis in 2001 had been a shock. No one in her family had ever had the autoimmune condition, and it had been difficult to diagnose. Doctors had first thought she had optic neuritis because her symptoms were in her eyes. Then they suspected lupus. After a spinal tap, she was diagnosed with MS. At the time, Amerson had never heard about the condition. She had just graduated from college and expected to be in the prime of her life. Instead, she had to give herself daily shots to treat the condition.

From a fake fair catch to a blind field goal lateral, these college football trick plays fooled defenses and changed games Coaches spend hours watching film to find tiny mistakes in how a team lines up. A good fake handoff, a surprise pass or a player acting like he isn't part of the play can flip a game upside down in a second. Some of these crazy calls led to famous touchdowns and huge wins. By the time the other team figures out what is going on, the ball is already gone.

From its humble beginnings in the 1980s, the festival has grown to become what organisers have called Europe's largest Halloween celebration. This year, Derry marked four decades of the festival with events inspired by folklore, mythology and the traditions of Samhain, the ancient Celtic festival from which Halloween has its roots.

CINCINNATI (AP) — Cincinnati Reds closer Emilio Pagán declined a $10 million player option for 2027 on Saturday, deciding to become a free agent.Cincinnati also declined a $16 million mutual option on third baseman/designated hitter Eugenio Suárez and an $8 million mutual option on right-hander Pierce Johnson, who gets a $1 million buyout. The 35-year-old right-hander has 90 saves in 10 major league seasons, the last three with the Reds.

Cincinnati will now need to find a closer for 2027, assuming they plan on ever having a lead in the 9th inning. The Hoggard girls tennis team claimed its first state title in program history with a dominant performance over Myers Park Saturday, Oct. 31. The Vikings capped their dominant 2026 season with a 5-1 victory over Myers Park on Friday, Oct. 31, at the Burlington Tennis Center to claim the NCHSAA 8A dual-team state championship. BALTIMORE (AP) — The Baltimore Orioles declined outfielder Luis Robert Jr.'s $20 million club option for 2027. The Chicago White Sox had picked up his $20 million option for 2026 before trading him to the Mets last offseason. The Golden State Valkyries won a WNBA championship by investing boldly in women’s basketball and building a winning culture from the ground up. BALTIMORE (AP) — Division III Johns Hopkins used an obscure rule to win its game against Muhlenberg on Saturday, prevailing 31-28 when Kaleb Wayt made a 39-yard field goal on a fair catch kick.When a player makes a fair catch, the receiving team has the option of attempting a field goal from that spot on the next play. Every now and then, it's attempted in the NFL, sometimes from unusually long distances, and the rule was added for college before this season. With the score tied at 28, Alex Orecchio made a fair catch on a short punt at the Muhlenberg 29. Then Wayt connected on the 39-yard field goal, putting the Blue Jays ahead with two seconds remaining.

Conference officials acknowledge a critical officiating blunder that gifted the Cougars an early lead, raising questions about replay accuracy as BYU prepares for a high-stakes rivalry matchup. "At 11:27 in the first period of the Arizona State-BYU game, Big 12 Replay Officials stopped the game to review possession by BYU. The play showed that the runner lost possession of the ball prior to the forward progress spot, and the ball was recovered by another BYU player at the two-yard line and he was awarded a touchdown. Rule 12-3-3-d-2 states, 'If the replay official rules that the ball was not dead, it belongs to the recovering team at the spot of the recovery and any advance is nullified.'"

Using a fake DOB or leaving the field blank when making an online account can offer protection from identity theft You get a call from your bank saying there has been suspicious activity on your account. They read out your name, address and date of birth so you are happy it is a legitimate caller. But you are talking to criminals who have used your date of birth as part of a web of verifying information to convince you they are someone else. Now cybersecurity professionals have warned people to resist entering a date of birth, or to put in a fake one, to limit the amount of personal data that is online, frustrating criminals’ attempts to “jigsaw” together personal profiles.
